input.rationale: Article VIX provides the Licensed Technology wholly "AS IS", disclaims all warranties "whether express or implied" (including merchantability, non-infringement, fitness, accuracy and title), and expressly negates any commitment that errors or non-conformity to Documentation will be corrected. There is no affirmative performance or conformance warranty anywhere in the Agreement and no repair/replace/refund remedy; the only related obligation is a "commercially reasonable efforts" Error Correction/Revisions support covenant (p0093–p0095), which is not a warranty and carries no remedy. This is the rule's walk-away position (AS IS with all warranties disclaimed and no conformance warranty), so it fails both the preferred and fallback positions. Our redline inserts the preferred express warranty package (professional and workmanlike services, 12-month software/Documentation conformance, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with a repair/replace/refund remedy, and carves the express warranties out of the disclaimer; the 90-day/30-day fallback periods are offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add express performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the AS IS disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently provided wholly "AS IS" with all express and implied warranties disclaimed, so we have no conformance warranty or remedy; our playbook requires an express warranty that the software conforms to its Documentation for twelve (12) months (services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner for ninety (90) days), backed by repair, replacement or refund, plus compliance with law and no malicious code. We have added that warranty and carved it out of the disclaimer; we can discuss a shorter ninety (90) day software / thirty (30) day services period as a fallback.
